text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon has managed to leave
quite a
mark on the Twinkle Series.

Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

One day, while still basking in the glory
of our
accomplishments...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I propose we play a game.
I listen carefully to what she has to say.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
After reviewing the data from the past
three
years, I've realized just how much I
have learned.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In particular, from an emotional
standpoint, I
experienced things such as
"joy," "frustration,"
and "the desire to
win."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Since my journey in the Twinkle Series
began, I
have observed many emotions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This led me to a query.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if the factors that induced
these
various emotions were present not
only in racing,
but in competition in and
of itself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To explore this, I decided upon an
activity in
which I am confident we can
compete on equal
footing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We stare at each other and try not to
laugh. The
first one to laugh loses. Will
you participate?
I decide to go along with her proposal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Also, the loser must do three laps
around town,
handstand walking. Now,
let's begin.
I could never make her do that... And there's no way I'm going to do it either.

If I want to nix the penalty game, I need
to win
this! I put all my effort into
pulling a funny face.

The sun eventually begins to set, but
we're still
locked in battle.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I sense your fatigue. Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I understand your predicament. We must
finish
the competition quickly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Doing three laps around town while
handstand
walking is rather difficult,
so...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The competition is over. I have lost.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As I thought, competition is a curious

phenomenon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of how it ends, I still get the
sense
that new feelings have developed
within me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This experience has also helped me
reconfirm
something...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Doing things together with you is... "fun."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Training, mountain climbing,
racing—everything is
enjoyable to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'll be off to walk across town on my
hands now. I
will return in time for
training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But I must serve my punishment for
losing...

Come what may, Mihono Bourbon and I
will keep
doing our best to take on new
challenges each
and every day.
